name: 音声の部屋で参加者の役割と保護を管理
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image2, LH03-0006, with exactly TWO corrections. PRIMARY ORIGINAL Image1 outranks the mock Image3 for icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical weight and fine details. Image3 only establishes the localized Japanese wording and layout.
1. Remove the MINT FILL from the small circular avatar next to「山田 はるか が共有」. Avatar must be PURE WHITE #FFFFFF with a fine neutral gray outline and existing forest-green「山」unchanged. No pale green anywhere.
2. Replace the generic two-person glyph next to「友だちの部屋」with the ORIGINAL friends glyph visible in Image1: three nested/overlapping rounded silhouettes around a central smiling face, rounded hair/head contour and compact curved shoulder/base; preserve source's recognizable specific geometry and proportions, with coherent slate #526173 linework. Do not reuse the generic two-circle icon from Image2 or the rough mock.
Keep EVERYTHING ELSE from Image2: portrait one-component composition, exact Japanese wording, small peace-hand emoji, downward chevron, ellipsis, title「初めてのライブ」, white external-link preview and glyph, all6action rows and target「佐藤 ゆう」, separate neutral「キャンセル」. First4action labels and leave remain consistent destructive coral, last2role actions remain forest green. Pure-white canvas/surfaces, fine neutral outlines, soft restrained shadows. No extra badges/actions/text.
Preserve Japanese Meiryo role metrics: heading20/28 Bold; actions14/24 Regular; category/leave12/16Bold; link/sharer/target/Cancel12/16Regular, tracking0, uniformly scaled. Keep all text intact, no wrapping changes or clipped content. This is a targeted correction, not a new layout.
reviewNotes: 修正画像を目視。アバターを白面と細い輪郭へ修正し、友だち記号を原画像の中央の笑顔と重なった輪郭へ修正。14項目の日本語、6操作、原画像から補ったメニュー・共有記号・退出絵文字を保持。4赤は退出/報告、2緑は役割管理の意味ある群。余計な機能や値なし。細部の厳密なベクトル同一性・フォント計測・参加者操作・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
